_comment: Sweep-4 — GaussianBlur_CUDA + BackgroundSubtraction_CUDA + ContourAreaFilter_CUDA, on top of pipelines/pipe-v2-clean.json (LensCorrection_CUDA/ProjectPointTo2DSurface_CPU disabled). MorphologyClose_CUDA/BinaryThreshold_CUDA held fixed at their pipe-v2-clean values (ksize=5, threshold=200 — sweep-2/3 winners).

_fixed_params.note: Fixed in the base pipeline (pipelines/pipe-v2-clean.json), not varied here.

pipeline.gaussian_kernel_size.rationale: Pre-blur kernel size ahead of background subtraction. Larger kernels suppress camera noise/reflections at the cost of edge sharpness for contour detection. New in sweep-4 — was fixed at 3 in pipe-v2-clean's baseline run.

pipeline.gaussian_sigma_x.rationale: Gaussian sigma paired with kernel_size (sigma_y mirrors the pipeline's own fixed value, not swept independently). New in sweep-4.

pipeline.bg_history.rationale: Carried over from sweep-3: shorter history = faster MOG2 adaptation (better for moving animals, worse for static/dead-animal absorption).

pipeline.contour_min_area.rationale: Re-testing the min_area elbow now that a Gaussian pre-blur sits ahead of background subtraction — the optimum may shift versus sweep-1/2, which had no pre-blur.

pipeline.contour_max_contours.rationale: max_contours=0 already confirmed bad (centroid smear, alpha=51px, sweep-1) and excluded here; re-confirming 1 vs 2 under the new pre-blur pipeline.
